description: This file defines the StableArrayAdapter class, a custom ArrayAdapter for managing a list of strings with stable IDs, used in Android list view implementation.

classes.name: StableArrayAdapter
classes.description: A custom ArrayAdapter that assigns stable IDs to list items using a HashMap for consistent item tracking.

methods.name: StableArrayAdapter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the adapter and mapping list items to their positions.

methods.name: getItemId
methods.description: Returns the stable ID for the item at the given position, or INVALID_ID if the position is invalid.

methods.name: hasStableIds
methods.description: Indicates that item IDs are stable across changes to the data set.
